name: US inflation
summary: US CPI 4.0% y/y in September; October data due mid-November
state: Headline CPI rose 4.0% in the year to September, up from 3.7%, within the 3–4.5% Watch band. Brent fell about 7% on 2 Nov on hopes of a US–Iran deal but remains far above a year ago. The Fed held at 3.75–4% on 28 Oct; October CPI is due mid-November.
for_you: Fuel, energy and transport costs are the main drivers; prices of everyday goods tend to follow with a lag.

sources.title: CBS News — Iran war live updates

why: Inflation sets Fed policy and thus global borrowing costs; a resurgence would keep rates high for everyone.
drivers: Energy, tariffs, wages, housing costs, supply chains.

rubric.watch: CPI 3.0–4.5%, or rising for 3 consecutive months.
